descriptions.description: Begonia heracleifolia, the star begonia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Begoniaceae. It is native to Mexico and northern Central America, and has been introduced to Cuba, Hispaniola, Puerto Rico, and Trinidad and Tobago. A widespread species that is adapted to drought, it possesses considerable genetic and morphological variation, particularly in leaf shape and patterning.
– Type: MEXICO • Hacienda de la Laguna, Baranca de Tioselo; 1828; Schiede 729; syntype: B [B 100243034].

Notes This species is distributed from Honduras to Nayarit State in western Mexico but widely cultivated beyond its natural range, including in Peru. All the specimens we have seen from Peru are from settlements and B. heracleifolia Schltdl. & Cham. does not seem to be widely naturalised.
